verdict.text: NO. Out of sample, after 0.10% fees, the PPO agent does not beat buy-and-hold on a risk-adjusted basis across seeds: its seed-mean Sharpe -1.92 is not above buy-and-hold's 0.64; only 0 of 5 seeds beat buy-and-hold's Sharpe; its Calmar -0.60 is not above buy-and-hold's 0.29. Net return: agent -100% on average over 5 seeds vs buy-and-hold +249% (max drawdown 100% vs 79%). Against the daily 30-day momentum rule (Sharpe 0.63, Calmar 0.34) the agent is not better on both.
